description: Header file defining the HpackStringDecoder class for decoding HPACK-encoded strings in HTTP/2 headers, including methods for starting and resuming decoding, and managing internal state.

classes.name: HpackStringDecoder
classes.description: Class responsible for decoding strings encoded with HPACK in HTTP/2 headers, managing decoding state, and invoking callbacks on a listener.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins decoding an HPACK string from the buffer, handling short strings directly or setting up for longer strings.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes decoding based on current internal state, processing additional data as needed.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the decoder's internal state for debugging.

methods.name: StartDecodingLength
methods.description: Decodes the length of the string, handling cases where length spans multiple bytes.

methods.name: ResumeDecodingLength
methods.description: Continues decoding the length if it was split across buffers.

methods.name: OnStringStart
methods.description: Invokes callback to signal start of string decoding.

methods.name: DecodeString
methods.description: Processes and passes string data to the listener, signaling completion when done.
